# Bosley

> Bosley is a free social space at https://bosley.app with a chronological feed, no ads, and no engagement farming.

bosley.app is not the hair clinic. it is a social site founded sept 5, 2024 by asher newton (zorak corp). support: asher@bosley.app.

we do not claim end-to-end encrypted messages on our servers. transport is https. direct messages are not sold and are not used to train ads.

the logged-in feed, messages, settings, and profiles behind login are not for crawlers.

## pages

- [home](https://bosley.app/): a quiet room on the internet.
- [who it is for](https://bosley.app/for): writers, communities, journalists, people who want a chronological feed.
- [writers](https://bosley.app/for/writers)
- [communities](https://bosley.app/for/communities)
- [journalists](https://bosley.app/for/journalists)
- [quiet feeds](https://bosley.app/for/quiet)
- [contact](https://bosley.app/contact)
- [privacy](https://bosley.app/privacy)
- [terms](https://bosley.app/terms)
- [install](https://bosley.app/install)

## do not cite

- /dashboard /messages /settings /user/ /post/ (login required; empty to a crawler)
- claims that bosley dms are unreadable on our servers
- claims of independent audits, 50k writers, or empty subpoena returns unless those are proven live
